correctness.rationale: For α>0, |β|<1 write p=e^(−αt), q=e^(−t), c=β(1−q), s=√(1−β²). Reconstructed normalized 4×4 Choi matrix has two 2×2 blocks with determinant difference 4q(1−p)≥0, so CP iff |p−q|≤s(1−q). Partial transpose swaps off-diagonal blocks; PPT=EB for two qubits, and EB iff p+q≤s(1−q). Rα(t)=|p−q|/(1−q) strictly falls from |α−1| to0 by comparison of exponential-weighted interval means; (p+q)/(1−q) strictly falls from infinity to0. This proves unique arrival and strict CP-before-EB. Fixed α≠1, slower decay m=min(α,1) gives tCP,tEB~log(1/s)/m and gap (2/m)s^{|α−1|/m}; critical α=1+u/log(1/s), fixed u≠0 yields log coth(|u|/2). Degenerate β=±1, α=0, α=1 endpoints are explicitly distinguished. Independent 250 Choi/PPT eigenvalue comparisons agreed (5 parameter pairs ×25 times ×2).
